# PR — 281_R6FIX.18 (BL-118): `no-raw-set-tenant` catches `set_config('app.tenant_id')`; substrate rides withTenant

**Base:** `main` @ `3a840396` · **Branch:** `stevevitali/r6fix-18-set-tenant-lint` · **mergePolicy:** OPERATOR

## Summary

BL-118 (277_R6LOW.1 sweep, RH-A1-9, REQ-DATA-4/REQ-ARCH-25): the tenant-scope lint rule matched
only raw `SET [LOCAL] app.tenant_id` — `set_config('app.tenant_id', …)`, the parameterized form
the wrapper itself uses, was invisible to it. Nine hand-rolled `begin → set_config → …` sites in
`packages/journeys`, one in the integration probe, and two live-clients probes bypassed the
withTenant-only invariant silently.

- **Rule:** second arm flags `set_config('app.tenant_id'|"app.tenant_id"` in literals/templates
  in every file except `packages/db/src/rls.ts` (filename-scoped allowlist — the only file that
  may name the GUC).
- **Substrate:** every hand-rolled block migrated to `withTenant` — stb5a ×5 (incl. the blind
  read's preserved null arm), stb5b `scopedQuery`, `steps` `ridingRefundTargets`,
  fixture-substrate, and the server-postgres isolation probe
  (`{ role: USER_SERVING_ROLE }` — the seam it pins).
- **Allowlist-with-justification:** the two `.mjs` probes keep the hand-roll behind
  `eslint-disable-next-line -- <reason>` — both deliberately ROLL BACK; `withTenant` commits on
  success, which would write to prod.
- **Cleanup:** dropped a duplicate `count` key the earlier union merge left in the journeys
  sign-in mock.

## Test plan

- Rule vitest: rls.ts `set_config` valid · other-file literal/template/double-quoted invalid ·
  raw `SET` arm still flagged.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/journeys/src tools/eslint-plugin-rhema` — 288/288.
- `pnpm turbo lint` — 46/46 packages green under the extended rule (zero remaining sites).
- `@rhema/journeys` typecheck + eslint clean on all touched files.
- No live journey legs run — seed/read paths verified offline; live legs keep their own gates.

CI is repository evidence, not deployed behavior.
